why: The last two intraday tests, written down before the first session they are scored on. The 20 held-out days of the multi-day replay were looked at many times, so these are judged only on sessions saved from score_from on. The long opening-range breakout is not tuned any further.
pass: every signal (Rs 10,000 each, after charges and turnover-scaled slippage) on the sessions its gate was open: the LOW end of the by-day 95% range of the net a signal is above zero. Judged at the first evening with at least 20 sessions scored and signals on at least 10 days; INCONCLUSIVE if that has not happened after 60 sessions. FAIL otherwise. Nothing is changed between now and the verdict.

tests.name: short below 30%, shortable intraday
tests.note: Short the first 5-minute close below the 15-minute opening-range low, from 10:00 to 11:00, on sessions whose 10:00 breadth is at or under 30%; stop at the range midpoint, target 2R, flat at 15:15. Only stocks INDstocks allows intraday (INTRADAY_LEVERAGE above 1), frozen in the list of 2026-11-17.

tests.name: rel. volume top 20, gate off
tests.note: Long the first 5-minute close above the 15-minute opening-range high, from 09:35 to 11:00, every session (no breadth gate, so no reason to wait for 10:00), only among the 20 charts with the highest opening-range volume over their own average of the 20 sessions before, chosen at 09:30; stop at the range midpoint, target 2R, flat at 15:15.
